title: Piper PA-28-181 Archer III — Normal Operating Procedures
description: Normal operating procedures for the Piper PA-28-181 Archer III with Lycoming O-360 carbureted engine. Covers preflight walk-around through shutdown and securing. Contains no numeric limitations; all airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, and performance values must be obtained from the specific aircraft POH. Equipment variations exist across this production run; verify against the specific aircraft.

source.notes: No manufacturer document consulted. Written from general familiarity with the Piper PA-28-181 Archer III and the Lycoming O-360 carbureted engine.

known_issues.description: Contains no airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities or other limitations — must come from aircraft POH.
Equipment variations exist across this model and variant, including presence or absence of cowl flaps and avionics configurations. Verify all items against the specific aircraft POH before use.

rights.notes: Piper POH remains under copyright. This file is independently authored and does not reproduce the wording or item selection of any manufacturer document.

items.text: Aircraft documents (ARROW) — airworthiness certificate, registration, radio station license, operating handbook, weight-and-balance data
Fuel quantity — visually verify each tank; quantity matches tabs or dipstick; sufficient for flight with required reserves
Fuel grade — confirm correct octane for the O-360 engine
Fuel sump — left wing tank quick-drain; sample checked for water and contamination
Fuel sump — right wing tank quick-drain; sample checked for water and contamination
Fuel sump — gascolator drain on lower engine firewall
Fuel caps — both wing tanks
Fuel selector — rotate through all positions; verify freedom of movement and positive detents
Engine oil level — dipstick check; verify quantity within acceptable operating range
items.response: WITHIN LIMITS PER POH; CAP SECURE

Cowling fasteners

Nose gear — strut extension, shimmy damper, tire condition, and tow bar removal
items.response: STRUT EXTENDED, TIRE SERVICEABLE, TOW BAR REMOVED

items.text: Pitot tube — cover removed, inlet clear
